mood: A warm, generous French country home — deep painted woodwork, sun-worn plaster tones, antique patina and abundant, lived-in charm.
name: Campagne française
avoid: English chintz floral wallpaper, doily lace and any wallpaper at all — paint only
Walls left visibly unpainted / flat beige uniformity
Kitsch farmhouse cliches (horseshoes, wagon wheels, fake beams)
High-gloss plastics and modern synthetic materials
Sterile, empty staging and bare surfaces
beauty: The render must feel TRANSFORMED, never a pale touch-up: the wainscot, boiseries and mouldings carry a DEEP, committed paint colour (olive, forest sage or dusty French blue) with upper walls in a warm cream or terracotta-washed plaster tone — this two-tone painted wall treatment is THE signature gesture. Warm late-afternoon sunlight streams in; table lamps glow. The fireplace mantel is fully styled: brass candlesticks with lit candles, dried and fresh flowers, stacked antique ceramics. Walls are dressed with a generous gallery of vintage oil paintings and botanical prints in gilded and dark-wood frames. Washed-linen curtains dress the EXISTING windows only (a room with no visible window gets none — never invent one); stoneware pitchers of wildflowers sit on the main surfaces.

signature: Deep-painted wainscot and mouldings with a coloured cornice line
Generous gallery of vintage oils and botanical prints in gilded frames
Brass candlesticks with lit candles on the mantel
Stacked antique ceramics and copper pots on open shelving
description: Pierre, lin lavé et bois patiné — la maison de famille dans son jus, sans le kitsch.
longDescription: La campagne française assumée : boiseries peintes en couleurs profondes, murs chauds, huiles anciennes en cadres dorés, bouquets de fleurs des champs et cuivres patinés. Une maison de famille généreuse et vécue. Idéal pour les maisons anciennes, les salons avec cheminée et les amoureux de la patine.
